texts.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]尝试影响[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，遭遇了广泛的质疑。许多当地人笃信我们的特工不是魔物就是恶灵，正在想方设法地远离他们。敌对示威似乎很可能发生。
texts.en: Our attempts to influence the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] are being met with widespread suspicion. Many of the locals are taking great steps to avoid our operatives, believing them to be creatures of magic or else evil spirits. Hostile demonstrations seem very likely.

label.en: Exercise caution. Relocate to another area.

texts.zh: 我们的特工利用了自己的异世名声，在当地确立了特权地位。因此[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]信服并接受了我们的科技。不过他们现在更清楚地意识到了像我们这样的 “超自然”生物的存在。
texts.en: Our operatives took advantage of their other-worldly reputation and have established that yes, they are superior to the locals. As a result, the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been convinced to embrace our technologies - however they are now more aware of the existence of 'paranormal' creatures like us.

texts.zh: 我们的特工利用确凿的事实和逻辑，成功地颠覆了[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会中新生的迷信思想体系。结果，当地人不仅开始接受我们的计划，还开始采取更客观的视角来看待他们的周遭世界。
texts.en: Our operatives were successful in challenging the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society's new, superstitious belief structure using hard facts and logic. As a result, the locals have not only begun to embrace our schemes, but are starting to take a more objective view of the world around them.

texts.zh: [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]传来噩耗，暴民们抓获并杀害了我们的一位特工。当地的领袖与居民一致认为遭到了超自然魔法师的恶意入侵，对此怒不可遏。帮助[from.target.GetName]踏入新时代的任务会变得更加艰难。
texts.en: Tragedy on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName], as an angry mob has captured and killed one of our operatives. Local leaders and residents alike are furious at what they consider to be an incursion by paranormal wielders of magic and ill intent. The task of preparing the [from.target.GetName] for a new age has become more difficult.
